name: Become an scp [Event + 3x Kills!]
desc:
CONSOLE : R1 - Switch tools | R2 - Shoot | R1 - AIM
This game was released pretty recently so expect bugs, maybe alot.
Available Scps : Scp 096, 457, 076, 106, 173, 966, 049.
This game is inspired by Scp Retrobreach and Scp Roleplay
HOW TO PLAY
You will spawn in as a guard, your objective is to kill SCPS. every second you play your chances of becoming an scp increases.
Every 4 people in server (Spectators don't count) Will be selected as an scp!

Scp containment breach
